requirement: Ops › Needs attention lists every offered quickstart with a broken or missing piece, counts it on the rail, and explains why the standard questionnaire does not fit

oracle.invariant: The script exits 0 and prints verdict PASS checks 37. The rail badge [data-attention-count] equals the count GET /api/ops/attention answers, and every [data-attention-area] count equals the server's per-area count, for every CMS and for Joomla alone. GET /api/ops/attention items carry only check, severity and params (no prose). Opening JA Impact's standard-questions item reads GET /api/ops/attention/questionnaire?tag=quickstart/ja-impact/j6 and shows the uncovered roles and the pages question as having no effect; ja-restaurant shows the no-contract limit and tracy-base/wp7 the identity-only limit. The Generate press reaches POST /api/ops/quickstart/questions/generate; a 503 is shown as an error, not a spinner. No pageerror and no console error.
